run_optimization: run the OPRO optimizer to minimize a linear regression loss function using an LLM
test_optimizer_server: test the LLM optimizer server by sending a simple yes/no prompt and verifying the response
generate_meta_prompt: generate a meta-prompt with sorted (w, b, loss) pairs for the LLM optimizer to propose new points
parse_llm_output: parse the LLM's bracket-enclosed w, b output string into a numpy array of floats
evaluate_loss: evaluate the squared residual loss for given w, b parameters against linear regression data
